counting_unit: unchanged fixed S candidate unit_id; source_word_count > 0; per category once per sentence
operation_mode_reporting: all positive modes included in primary descriptive presence, with mode-specific values retained; do not interpret as executed or personally experienced
measurement_condition_required: explicit period, input, configuration, trials or cumulative scope; one or more referenced S unit IDs
zero_words: context only; never add to S count; density NA when article W_S=0
article_label: present if n_present>0, otherwise uncertain if n_uncertain>0, otherwise absent
count_bounds: [n_present,n_present+n_uncertain]; retain uncertainty even in positive articles
context_only: record body quote offsets and category separately; excluded from S presence, count and density
overlap: retain category overlaps and sentence union; sum of categories is not independent evidence count
article_type_source: primary purpose of full saved body; secondary types allowed; rationale required; no metadata copy
evaluation_access_gate: content-rubric checkpoint AND separately frozen proxy-rules checkpoint required before evaluation text display
